title: FPS Inventory System
subtitle: Gameplay Prototype
description: A Unity prototype for a first-person shooter inventory and interaction system, including weapon pickup, switching, and UI-based management. Designed with a test-ready gameplay loop and refined through iterative debugging to ensure smooth and responsive player interactions.

mechanics.title: Weapon Pickup & Switching
mechanics.description: Seamless weapon pickup, inventory management, and switching logic with a clean UI-driven experience built for test-ready prototyping.

mechanics.title: UI-Based Management
mechanics.description: A responsive inventory HUD system that visually communicates weapon states, ammo counts, and interaction prompts clearly to the player.

mechanics.title: Player Interaction System
mechanics.description: Raycasting-based interaction system allowing the player to pick up, drop, and cycle weapons with tight, responsive feel tuning.

mechanics.title: Iterative Polish
mechanics.description: Refined through multiple playtest cycles to ensure smooth, bug-free gameplay loops and responsive player feedback at all times.

title: The Cursed Chaos
subtitle: Horror Game
description: A Unity-based first-person horror prototype focused on exploration and survival. Implemented player controls, interaction systems, and atmosphere-driven level design, with a complete gameplay loop to support playtesting. Iterated on lighting, game feel, and responsiveness based on feedback.

mechanics.title: Atmosphere-Driven Level Design
mechanics.description: Carefully crafted environments that build tension through lighting, sound design cues, and environmental storytelling to keep the player on edge.

mechanics.title: Player Controls & Interaction
mechanics.description: Tight first-person controls with interaction systems that allow the player to examine objects and navigate the environment fluidly.

mechanics.title: Complete Gameplay Loop
mechanics.description: A full exploration and survival loop designed for playtesting — from starting area to end trigger — with iterative improvements based on feedback.

mechanics.title: Game Feel Tuning
mechanics.description: Spent multiple iteration cycles tuning responsiveness, post-processing effects, and camera behaviour to maximize immersion and horror impact.
